author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: Under explicit polynomial-workspace coefficient and rational-support unranking contracts, each entry of both Pauli/Bell factors after cyclic conjugation can be computed in polynomial workspace and 2^O(lambda) poly(log p) time over good prime fields, without materializing exponential matrices. No full recursive polynomial-space SAT algorithm or improved rho or alpha is claimed.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the explicit factor and support-unranking arguments
Complete space accounting across recursive tensor descriptions, enumeration, CRT and outer reduction
A cheaper crossing family satisfying both rank bounds and all uniformity conditions
